entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-رَجُلٌ هَمِيزُ الْفُؤَادِ : ذَكِيٌّ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: aql-zakovati o‘tkir, zukko
meanings.uzbekExample: U aql-zakovati o‘tkir, zukko kishi edi.

issues: Mavjud «aqlli, zukkolik» birikmasidagi ot shakli sifat ma’nosiga moslashtirildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-رَمْلٌ عَرِيكٌ : مُتَدَاخِلٌ بَعْضُهُ فِي بَعْضٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qum haqida: qismlari yoki zarralari bir-biriga kirishib, zich aralashib ketgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Qum zarralari bir-biriga kirishib ketgan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-سَمِعَ حَسِيساً خَلْفَ البَابِ : صَوْتاً خَفِيّاً.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: sekin eshitiladigan, bilinar-bilinmas tovush
meanings.uzbekExample: U eshik ortidan bilinar-bilinmas tovush eshitdi.

issues: حَسِيسٌ bu yerda sifat emas, eshitilgan bilinar-bilinmas tovushni bildiruvchi ot

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-سَمِيكُ الحَجْمِ :ثَخِينٌ، غَلِيظٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: hajmi yoki kesimi qalin, yo‘g‘on
meanings.uzbekExample: U qalin va yo‘g‘on hajmli edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-شَابٌّ فَسِيقٌ : كَثِيرُ الفِسْقِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ko‘p fisq-fujur va gunoh ish qiladigan, itoatsizlikda davom etadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U ko‘p fisq-fujur qiladigan yigit edi.

issues: كَثِيرُ الفِسْقِ oddiy «gunohkor»dan kuchliroq: fisq-fujurni ko‘p qiluvchi ma’nosi saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-شَابٌّ وَدِيدٌ : مُحِبٌّ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: boshqalarni sevuvchi, mehr-muhabbatli
meanings.uzbekExample: U mehr-muhabbatli yigit edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-شَجَرٌ وَرِيقٌ : أَيْ وَرَقُهُ ظَاهِرٌ، وَارِقٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: daraxt haqida: barglari ko‘rinib turgan, barg yozgan yoki serbarg
meanings.uzbekExample: Daraxt barg yozib, serbarg bo‘lib turardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-شَعْرٌ مَشِيطٌ : شَعْرٌ مَمْشُوطٌ، مُسَرَّحٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: soch haqida: taroq bilan taralgan va tartibga keltirilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning sochi taralib, tartibga keltirilgan edi.

issues: Mavjud «tarashgan soch» o‘zbekcha tabiiy birikma emas; «taralgan va tartibga keltirilgan» bilan tuzatildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-صَبِيٌّ خَتِينٌ : مَنْ قُطِعَتْ قُلْفَتُهُ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘g‘il bola yoki erkak haqida: olatining sunnat terisi kesilgan, sunnat qilingan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bola sunnat qilingan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-ضَرْبٌ وَجِيعٌ : مُوجِعٌ، مُؤْلِمُ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: zarba yoki ta’sir haqida: qattiq og‘riq beradigan, og‘riqli
meanings.uzbekExample: U og‘riq beradigan zarba oldi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-طَعَامٌ نَزِيرٌ : قَلِيلٌ جِدّاً- عَطَاءٌ نَزِيرٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: miqdori juda oz yoki arzimas darajada kam
meanings.uzbekExample: Taom juda oz, berilgan narsa ham arzimas darajada kam edi.

issues: Taom va beriladigan narsa misollari bitta «juda oz» ma’nosida saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-عَجيجُ الوَلَدِ : صُياحُهُ- وَلَيْسَ عَجِيجُهَا هَذَا الَّذِي تَسْمَعُ إِلاَّ مَظْهَراً مِنْ مَظَاهِرِ الْغَيْظِ.

meanings.arabicGloss: صُياحُهُ- وَلَيْسَ عَجِيجُهَا هَذَا الَّذِي تَسْمَعُ إِلاَّ مَظْهَراً مِنْ مَظَاهِرِ الْغَيْظِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: baland qichqiriq, baqiriq-chaqiriq yoki shovqin
meanings.uzbekExample: Bolaning ajiji — uning qichqirig‘i. Siz eshitayotgan bu shovqin uning g‘azabi namoyon bo‘lishidan boshqa narsa emas.

issues: G‘azabning namoyon bo‘lishi alohida lug‘aviy ma’no emas, shovqinni tavsiflovchi manba misolidir

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-فَأْسٌ فَصِيمٌ : ضَخْمَةٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bolta haqida: katta va ulkan
meanings.uzbekExample: U katta bolta ko‘tardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-فَنَّانٌ رَبِيزٌ : ماهِرٌ، بارِعٌ فِي فَنِّهِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: san’atkor haqida: o‘z san’atida mohir, mahoratli va ustasi farang
meanings.uzbekExample: U o‘z san’atida mohir ijodkor edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-فِي هَزِيجٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ : فِي طائِفَةٍ مِنْهُ. ن. هَزِيعٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kechaning bir bo‘lagi yoki ma’lum qismi
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu voqea kechaning bir qismida sodir bo‘ldi.

issues: Manbadagi «ن. هَزِيعٌ» shu ma’nodagi boshqa yozuvga havola; yangi ma’no sifatida ajratilmadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-قَطِينُ الدَّارِ : سَاكِنُهَا، القَاطِنُ فِيهَا.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: uyda yoki biror joyda yashovchi, u yerda istiqomat qiluvchi kishi
meanings.uzbekExample: U shu uyning yashovchisi edi.

issues: قَطِينُ الدَّارِ uyda yashovchi shaxsni bildiradi; so‘z turkumi otga tuzatildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-قُطْنٌ نَدِيفٌ : مَنْدُوفٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: paxta haqida: tolalari ajratilib titilgan yoki savalangan
meanings.uzbekExample: Titilgan paxta yumshoq va g‘ovak bo‘lib turardi.

issues: مَنْدُوفٌ «toza, sof» emas, tolalari titilgan yoki savalangan paxtadir

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-كَانَ شَفِيقاً بِهِ :مُشْفِقاً، رَؤُوفاً بِهِ، شَفُوقاً.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: biror kishiga mehribon, rahmdil va g‘amxo‘r munosabatda bo‘ladigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U unga mehribon va g‘amxo‘r edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-لَحْمٌ هَرِيءٌ : لَحْمٌ أُجِيدَ إِنْضَاجُهُ فَتَهَرَّأَ حَتَّى سَقَطَ عَنِ الْعَظْمِ.
entries.uzbek: yumshab, suyakdan ajraladigan darajada pishgan go‘sht

meanings.arabicGloss: لَحْمٌ أُجِيدَ إِنْضَاجُهُ فَتَهَرَّأَ حَتَّى سَقَطَ عَنِ الْعَظْمِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: go‘sht haqida: yaxshi pishib, juda yumshagan va suyakdan o‘zi ajraladigan holga kelgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Go‘sht juda yaxshi pishib, suyakdan ajralib tushdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-مَعْدِنٌ صَهِيرٌ : مُذَابٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: metall haqida: issiqlik ta’sirida eritilib, suyuq holga keltirilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Eritilgan metall qolipga quyildi.

issues: «Suyuq holatga kelgan» umumiy ma’no emas; manba aynan eritilgan metallni bildiradi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-مَعْدِنُ ذَهيبٌ : مُمَوَّهٌ بِالذَّهَبِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: metall haqida: yuzasiga oltin suvi yuritilgan yoki oltin bilan qoplangan
meanings.uzbekExample: Metall buyumga oltin suvi yuritilgan edi.

issues: Manba oltin tusni emas, metall yuzasiga oltin suvi yuritilganini bildiradi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-نَصْلٌ رَميضٌ : حادٌّ- صَنَعَ نِصالاً رَميضَةً.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tig‘ yoki pichoq haqida: yaxshi charxlangan, o‘tkir
meanings.uzbekExample: U o‘tkir tig‘lar yasadi.

issues: «O‘tkir qilinadigan» alohida ma’no emas; ikkinchi ibora o‘tkir tig‘lar yasash haqidagi misol

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-هُوَ خَدِيمُهُ : عَامِلٌ تَحْتَ تَصَرُّفهِ، يَشْتَغِلُ بِأمْرِهِ .

meanings.uzbekMeaning: biror kishining ixtiyori yoki boshqaruvi ostida uning topshirig‘ini bajarib ishlovchi xizmatkor
meanings.uzbekExample: U uning xizmatkori bo‘lib, topshiriqlarini bajarardi.

issues: خَدِيمٌ bu ta’rifda sifat emas, xizmat qiluvchi shaxs nomi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-هُوَ عَشِيقُهَا : كَثِيرُ العِشْقِ لَهَا.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: biror kishini qattiq sevadigan oshiq yoki ma’shuq
meanings.uzbekExample: U unga qattiq oshiq edi.

issues: عَشِيقُهَا munosabatdagi shaxsni bildiradi; ot sifatida berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-هُوَ في عَيْشٍ رَغيدٍ : في عَيْشٍ مُريحٍ، هَنيءٍ، مُتَّسِعٍ- يا لَهُ مِنْ عَيْشٍ رَغيدٍ !.

meanings.arabicGloss: في عَيْشٍ مُريحٍ، هَنيءٍ، مُتَّسِعٍ- يا لَهُ مِنْ عَيْشٍ رَغيدٍ !.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: turmush yoki hayot haqida: farovon, rohatli, ko‘ngildagidek va imkoniyati keng
meanings.uzbekExample: U farovon va rohatli hayot kechirdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-هُوَ في عَيْشٍ رَفيهٍ : في عَيْشٍ رَغيدٍ، فيهِ ما لَذَّ وَطابَ.

meanings.arabicGloss: في عَيْشٍ رَغيدٍ، فيهِ ما لَذَّ وَطابَ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: hayot yoki turmush haqida: farovon, ne’matlarga boy, unda lazzatli va yaxshi narsalar mavjud
meanings.uzbekExample: U farovon va ne’matlarga boy hayot kechirardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-هُوَ مِنْ أُسْرَةٍ مَجْدُهَا مَجْدٌ أَثِيلٌ : مُتَأصِّل فِي الشَّرَفِ.

meanings.arabicExample: هُوَ مِنْ أُسْرَةٍ مَجْدُهَا مَجْدٌ أَثِيلٌ
meanings.uzbekMeaning: sharaf, obro‘ yoki ulug‘lik haqida: ildizi chuqur, qadimdan qaror topgan va mustahkam
meanings.uzbekExample: U sharafi qadimdan mustahkam qaror topgan oiladan edi.

issues: «Aslzoda» shaxs ma’nosiga siljiydi; manbada oilaning sharafi qadimiy va ildizli ekani aytilgan

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-وَجَدْتُهُ كَئِيباً : حَزِيناً، مُنْكَسِرَ النَّفْسِ، مُغْتَمّاً.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: g‘amga botgan, dili siniq va ruhiy tushkun holatda
meanings.uzbekExample: Men uni g‘amgin va tushkun holatda ko‘rdim.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-وَلَدٌ خَطِيفٌ : سَرِيعُ الْمَشْيِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: tez yuradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bola tez yurardi.

issues: Manba umumiy chaqqonlikni emas, aynan tez yurishni bildiradi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-وَلَدٌ خَمِيجٌ : سَيِّئُ الذِّكْرِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: odamlar orasida yomon nom chiqargan, badnom yoki obro‘siz
meanings.uzbekExample: U yomon nom chiqargan bola edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-وَلَدٌ رَميسٌ : أَيْ رُمِيَ بِحَجَرٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: otilgan tosh tekkan yoki tosh bilan urilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bolaga otilgan tosh tegdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-وَلَدٌ غَبِينٌ : ضَعِيفُ الرَّأْيِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: fikri, mulohazasi yoki qaror chiqarish qobiliyati zaif
meanings.uzbekExample: Bolaning fikri va mulohazasi zaif edi.

issues: «Noto‘g‘ri qaror qiluvchi» manbadan kelib chiqadigan majburiy ma’no emas; ضَعِيفُ الرَّأْيِ fikr-mulohaza zaifligini bildiradi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-وَلَدٌ نَغِيلٌ : وَلَدٌ فَاسِدُ النَّسَبِ، وَلَدٌ مِنْ زِنىً.

meanings.arabicGloss: وَلَدٌ فَاسِدُ النَّسَبِ، وَلَدٌ مِنْ زِنىً.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: nikohdan tashqari jinsiy munosabat natijasida tug‘ilgan; tarixiy manbalarda kamsituvchi sifat sifatida ishlatilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Eski manbada bu sifat nikohsiz munosabatdan tug‘ilgan bolaga nisbatan qo‘llangan.

issues: «Nasabi buzilgan» kamsituvchi va noaniq; bevosita ta’rif neytral shaklda, tarixiy qo‘llanish yorlig‘i bilan berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-وَلَدٌ وَمِيقٌ : مَحْبُوبٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: boshqalar tomonidan seviladigan, sevimli va suyukli
meanings.uzbekExample: U oilasining sevimli farzandi edi.

issues: مَحْبُوبٌ «sevimli, suyukli» degani; umumiy «yoqimli» ma’nosi olib tashlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-وَلَدُ رَعيشٌ : مُرْتَعِدٌ، مُرْتَجِفٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qo‘rquv, sovuq yoki boshqa sababdan titrayotgan, qaltirayotgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bola titrab-qaltirab turardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-يَا لَهُ مِنْ رَجُلٍ تَعِيسٍ : شَقِيٍّ، تَعِسٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: baxtdan yiroq, baxtsiz yoki badbaxt
meanings.uzbekExample: U naqadar baxtsiz kishi edi.

issues: «Omadsiz»dan ko‘ra manbadagi شَقِيٌّ kuchliroq baxtsizlik va badbaxtlikni bildiradi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-يَوْمٌ مَطِيرٌ : أَيْ مُمْطِرٌ- يَوْم مِنْ أَيَّامِ الزَّمْهَرِيرِ عَاصِفٌ قَارِسٌ مَطِيرٌ.

meanings.arabicGloss: أَيْ مُمْطِرٌ- يَوْم مِنْ أَيَّامِ الزَّمْهَرِيرِ عَاصِفٌ قَارِسٌ مَطِيرٌ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: kun yoki ob-havo haqida: yomg‘ir yog‘adigan, seryomg‘ir
meanings.uzbekExample: Qahraton kun bo‘ronli, ayozli va yomg‘irli edi.

issues: Sovuq va shamolli bo‘lishi مَطِيرٌ ma’nosi emas, manba misolidagi kunning boshqa sifatlaridir

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-يَوْمٌ وَجِيمٌ : شَدِيدُ الْحَرِّ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kun yoki ob-havo haqida: issig‘i juda kuchli
meanings.uzbekExample: Kun juda issiq edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|-يَوْمٌ وَحِيمٌ : شَدِيدُ الْحَرِّ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kun yoki ob-havo haqida: issig‘i juda kuchli
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu kunning issig‘i juda kuchli edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).| مَا أُثْبِتَ فِي الأَرْضِ مِنْ شَجَرٍ أَوْ نَبَاتٍ.

meanings.arabicGloss: مَا أُثْبِتَ فِي الأَرْضِ مِنْ شَجَرٍ أَوْ نَبَاتٍ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: yerga ekilgan yoki o‘tqazilgan daraxt yoxud boshqa o‘simlik
meanings.uzbekExample: Yerga o‘tqazilgan daraxt va o‘simliklar parvarish qilindi.

issues: Ta’rif ekilgan daraxt yoki o‘simlikning o‘zini bildiradi; so‘z turkumi otga tuzatildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).| جِلْدٌ مَدْبُوغٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: maxsus ishlov berib oshlangan teri
meanings.uzbekExample: Oshlangan teridan buyum tayyorlandi.

issues: Teri sanoatidagi aniq o‘zbekcha «oshlangan teri» atamasi tanlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1-  مَزِيجٌ مِنْ عَصِيرِ الفَوَاكِهِ : الْمَمْزُوجُ مِنْهَا، مَا مُزِجَ مِنَ السَّوَائِلِ.|2- حَدِيثٌ مَزِيجٌ بِالْهَزْلِ : فِي ثَنَايَاه هَزْلٌ، مَمْزُوجٌ.

meanings.arabicGloss: الْمَمْزُوجُ مِنْهَا، مَا مُزِجَ مِنَ السَّوَائِلِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: ikki yoki undan ortiq suyuqlik qo‘shilishidan hosil bo‘lgan aralashma
meanings.uzbekExample: Ichimlik turli meva sharbatlari aralashmasidan tayyorlandi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: gap yoki suhbat haqida: orasiga hazil qo‘shilgan, hazil aralash
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning gapida hazil ham bor edi.

issues: Birinchi ma’no suyuqliklar aralashmasi bo‘lgan ot, ikkinchisi hazil aralash nutqni bildiruvchi sifat

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- اِخْتَبَأَ فِي مَكَانٍ حَصِينٍ : مَنِيعٍ.|2- كَنْزٌ حَصِينٌ : فِي مَكَانٍ مَنِيعٍ مُحْكَمٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: joy haqida: kirish qiyin bo‘lgan, daxlsiz va mustahkam himoyalangan
meanings.uzbekExample: U mustahkam himoyalangan joyga yashirindi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: xazina yoki qimmatbaho narsa haqida: mahkam, puxta himoyalangan joyda saqlanadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Xazina mahkam himoyalangan joyda saqlanardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- اِرْتَكَبَ خَطَأً طَفِيفاً : بَسِيطاً.|2- سَلَّمَهُ مَبْلَغاً طَفِيفاً : قَلِيلاً جِدًّا.|3- أَمْرٌ طَفِيفٌ : خَسِيسٌ، حَقِيرٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: xato yoki kamchilik haqida: kichik, yengil va jiddiy bo‘lmagan
meanings.uzbekExample: U kichik xatoga yo‘l qo‘ydi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: pul yoki miqdor haqida: juda oz
meanings.uzbekExample: Unga juda oz pul berdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ish yoki narsa haqida: qadrsiz, arzimas va e’tiborga noloyiq
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu arzimas ish deb baholandi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- أَرْضٌ خَضِيٌر : أَرْضُ العُشْبِ الأَخْضَرِ.|2- بَقْلٌ خَضِيرٌ : ذُو خُضْرَةٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yer haqida: yashil o‘t-o‘lan bilan qoplangan, yam-yashil
meanings.uzbekExample: Yer yam-yashil o‘t-o‘lan bilan qoplangan edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘t-o‘lan yoki ko‘kat haqida: yashil, ko‘m-ko‘k
meanings.uzbekExample: Daladagi o‘t-o‘lan ko‘m-ko‘k edi.

issues: Manbada «o‘tloq» va «sabzavot» otlari emas, yer hamda o‘t-o‘lanning yashillik sifati berilgan

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- أَمْرٌ عَوِيصٌ :شَائِكٌ، صَعْبٌ.|2- أَتَى بِكَلاَمٍ عَوِيصٍ : كَلاَمٌ يَصْعُبُ فَهْمُهُ- قَضَايَا عَوِيصَةٌ :-وَاجَهَ مَسْأَلَةً عَوِيصَةً.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ish yoki masala haqida: chigal, og‘ir va yechimi qiyin
meanings.uzbekExample: U chigal va qiyin masalaga duch keldi.

meanings.arabicGloss: كَلاَمٌ يَصْعُبُ فَهْمُهُ- قَضَايَا عَوِيصَةٌ :-وَاجَهَ مَسْأَلَةً عَوِيصَةً.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: gap yoki fikr haqida: mazmunini anglash qiyin, tushunarsiz darajada murakkab
meanings.uzbekExample: U tushunish mushkul bo‘lgan gap aytdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- أَمْرٌ فَرِيءٌ : مُخْتَلَقٌ.|2- عَمَلٌ فَرِيءٌ : عَظِيمٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: gap, da’vo yoki ish haqida: to‘qib chiqarilgan, uydirma
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu to‘qib chiqarilgan gap edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ish yoki amalga nisbatan: ulkan, buyuk
meanings.uzbekExample: U ulkan ishni amalga oshirdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- تَمْتَلِئُ الْحُقُولُ بِالْهَشِيمِ فِي الصَّيْفِ : يَابِسُ النَّبَاتِ وَالشَّجَرِ- وَجَدَتِ النَّارُ فِي الْهَشِيمِ مَرْتَعاً لِتَمْتَدَّ إِلَى كُلِّ الْحُقُولِ الْمُجَاوِرَةِ.|2.الكهف آية 45فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيماً تَذْرُوهُ الرِّيَاحُ (قرآن) : الْمَهْشُومُ الْمُتَكَسِّرُ.|3- وَلَدٌ هَشِيمٌ : ضَعِيفُ الْبَدَنِ.
entries.uzbek: qurigan o‘simlik qoldig‘i; uvulib singan; nimjon

meanings.arabicGloss: يَابِسُ النَّبَاتِ وَالشَّجَرِ- وَجَدَتِ النَّارُ فِي الْهَشِيمِ مَرْتَعاً لِتَمْتَدَّ إِلَى كُلِّ الْحُقُولِ الْمُجَاوِرَةِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: qurib qolgan o‘t-o‘lan, daraxt shoxlari va o‘simlik qoldiqlari
meanings.uzbekExample: Yozda dalalar qurigan o‘simlik qoldiqlariga to‘ladi; olov ular orqali qo‘shni dalalarga yoyildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qurib, sinib-uvulib ketgan o‘simlik yoki narsa
meanings.uzbekExample: U shamollar sovuradigan quruq xas-xashakka aylandi. (Qur’on, Kahf surasi, 18:45)

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: jismi zaif, nimjon
meanings.uzbekExample: U jismi zaif, nimjon bola edi.

issues: Kahf surasi 18:45 misoli shamol sovuradigan, sinib-uvulgan quruq o‘simlik qoldig‘i ma’nosida tarjima qilindi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- ثَمَرٌ يَنِيعٌ : نَاضِجٌ وَحَانَ قِطَافُهُ.|2- وَلَدٌ يَنِيعٌ : بَلَغَ سِنَّ النُّضْجِ وَصَارَ غَايَةً فِي الْكَمَالِ وَالنَّظَافَةِ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: meva haqida: to‘liq pishgan va terib olish vaqti kelgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Meva pishib, terimga kelgan edi.

meanings.arabicGloss: بَلَغَ سِنَّ النُّضْجِ وَصَارَ غَايَةً فِي الْكَمَالِ وَالنَّظَافَةِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola yoki yosh kishi haqida: yetuklik yoshiga yetgan, kamol va pokizalikda yuqori darajaga chiqqan
meanings.uzbekExample: U kamolga yetgan, ozoda va barkamol yigit bo‘ldi.

issues: Mevaning terim vaqti kelgani hamda inson ma’nosidagi pokizalik tafsiloti tiklandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- ثَمَنٌ زَهِيدٌ : ثَمَنٌ رَخيصٌ جِدّاً، ضَئيلٌ، تافِهٌ- اِشْتَرَى حِذاءً بِثَمَنٍ زَهيدٍ :-أَثْمانٌ زَهيدَةٌ :-لَمْ يَحْصُلْ إِلاَّ عَلَى مَبْلَغٍ زَهيدٍ.|2- رَجُلٌ زَهيدٌ : حَقيرٌ، لَئيمٌ.
entries.uzbek: juda arzon yoki oz; haqir va pastkash

meanings.arabicGloss: ثَمَنٌ رَخيصٌ جِدّاً، ضَئيلٌ، تافِهٌ- اِشْتَرَى حِذاءً بِثَمَنٍ زَهيدٍ :-أَثْمانٌ زَهيدَةٌ :-لَمْ يَحْصُلْ إِلاَّ عَلَى مَبْلَغٍ زَهيدٍ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: narx haqida: juda arzon; pul yoki miqdor haqida: juda oz va arzimas
meanings.uzbekExample: U poyabzalni juda arzon narxda sotib oldi, o‘zi esa ozgina pul oldi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: haqir, qadrsiz yoki pastkash
meanings.uzbekExample: Manbada u haqir va pastkash kishi deb ta’riflangan.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- ثَوْبٌ ضَرِيجٌ : مَصْبُوغٌ بِحُمْرَةٍ.|2- بَطَلٌ ضَرِيجٌ : قَوِيٌّ، شَدِيدٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: mato yoki kiyim haqida: qizil rangga bo‘yalgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Mato qizil rangga bo‘yalgan edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qahramon yoki jangchi haqida: baquvvat, kuchli va shiddatli
meanings.uzbekExample: U kuchli va shiddatli qahramon edi.

issues: Ikkinchi ma’nodagi شَدِيدٌ qahramonning kuchi va shiddatiga tegishli, umumiy «qattiq» emas

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- جَعَلَتْ شَعْرَهَا ضَفِيراً : مَنْسُوجاً، مَضْفُوراً.|2- ضَفِيرُ البَحْرِ : سَاحِلُهُ، شَطُّهُ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: soch haqida: tolalari bir-biriga o‘rilib, kokil qilingan
meanings.uzbekExample: U sochini o‘rib qo‘ydi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: dengizning sohili yoki qirg‘og‘i
meanings.uzbekExample: Ular dengiz sohiliga yetib bordilar.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- جَلَسَ رَزِيناً فِي مَقْعَدِهِ : سَاكِناً، ثَابِتاً.|2- عَرَفْتُهُ شَابّاً رَزِيناً : وَقُوراً، حَلِيماً.|3- عَرَفْتُهُ رَزِينَ الرَّأْيِ : أصِيلَ الرَّأْيِ.
entries.uzbek: tinch va qimirlamas; vazmin; fikri puxta

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘tirish yoki turish holatida: tinch, qimirlamas va barqaror
meanings.uzbekExample: U o‘rindig‘ida tinch va qimirlamay o‘tirdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: vazmin, bosiq va muloyim
meanings.uzbekExample: Men uni vazmin va bosiq yigit sifatida tanirdim.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: fikr va mulohaza haqida: puxta, asosli va teran
meanings.uzbekExample: Men uning fikrini puxta va asosli deb bilardim.

issues: Uchinchi ma’no umumiy donolik emas, fikrning puxtaligi va asosliligidir

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- حَارِسٌ عَتِيدٌ : حَاضِرٌ.ق آية 18مَا يَلْفِظُ مِنْ قَوْلٍ إِلاَّ لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ (قرآن).|2- مَوْقِفٌ عَتِيدٌ : صَلْبٌ شَدِيدٌ.|3- رَجُلٌ عَتِيدٌ : مُهَيَّأٌ للِشَّدَائِدِ.
entries.uzbek: hozir va tayyor; sobit; qiyinchilikka shay

meanings.arabicGloss: حَاضِرٌ.ق آية 18مَا يَلْفِظُ مِنْ قَوْلٍ إِلاَّ لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ (قرآن).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: kuzatuvchi yoki qo‘riqchi haqida: hozir bo‘lgan va tayyor turgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U biror so‘z aytmasinki, uning oldida hoziru nozir kuzatuvchi bo‘lmasin. (Qur’on, Qof surasi, 50:18)

meanings.uzbekMeaning: mavqe yoki tutum haqida: sobit, mustahkam va qat’iy
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning tutgan mavqeyi qat’iy va mustahkam edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: qiyinchilik va og‘ir sinovlarga oldindan shaylangan, tayyor
meanings.uzbekExample: U qiyinchiliklarga tayyor kishi edi.

issues: Qof surasi 50:18 misoli hoziru nozir va tayyor kuzatuvchi ma’nosida berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- حَاسَبَهُ حِسَاباً عَسِيراً : شَدِيداً.|2- يَعِيشُ وَضْعاً عَسِيراً : صَعْباً، شَاقّاً. | الفرقان آية 26وَكَانَ يَوْماً عَلَى الكَافِرِينَ عَسِيراً (قرآن) :وَاجَهَتْهُ مَسْأَلَةٌ عَسِيرَةٌ :-إِنَّ مِنَ العَسِيرِ أَنْ أَتَصَوَّرَ الْجَمَالَ غَيْرَ مُقْتَرِنٍ بِالفَضِيلَةِ. (توفيق الحكيم).

meanings.uzbekMeaning: hisob-kitob yoki tekshiruv haqida: qattiq, shafqatsiz va sinchkov
meanings.uzbekExample: U undan qattiq hisob so‘radi.

meanings.arabicGloss: صَعْباً، شَاقّاً. | الفرقان آية 26وَكَانَ يَوْماً عَلَى الكَافِرِينَ عَسِيراً (قرآن) :وَاجَهَتْهُ مَسْأَلَةٌ عَسِيرَةٌ :-إِنَّ مِنَ العَسِيرِ أَنْ أَتَصَوَّرَ الْجَمَالَ غَيْرَ مُقْتَرِنٍ بِالفَضِيلَةِ. (توفيق الحكيم).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: vaziyat, kun, masala yoki ish haqida: qiyin, mushkul va mashaqqatli
meanings.uzbekExample: U qiyin vaziyatda yashamoqda. U kun kofirlar uchun og‘ir kundir. (Qur’on, Furqon surasi, 25:26)

issues: Mavjud tarjimada uch ma’no ko‘rsatilgan, manba tuzilmasida esa ikkita: qattiq hisob va qiyin-mashaqqatli holat
Furqon surasi 25:26 misoli ikkinchi ma’noda saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- حَضَّرَتِ الْعَجِينَ لِتُهَيِّءَ خُبْزَهَا : الدَّقِيقُ الْمَعْجُونُ بِالْمَاءِ- الخَمِيرُ الَّذِي يُخَمِّرُ الْعَجِينَ كُلَّهُ.|2- هُوَ عَجِينُ يَدِي : أَيْ أَنَا الَّذِي كَوَّنْتُهُ وَصَنَعْتُهُ، وَأَنَا خَبِيرٌ بِهِ.

meanings.arabicGloss: الدَّقِيقُ الْمَعْجُونُ بِالْمَاءِ- الخَمِيرُ الَّذِي يُخَمِّرُ الْعَجِينَ كُلَّهُ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: un yoki unga o‘xshash mahsulotni suv bilan qorishdan hosil bo‘ladigan xamir
meanings.uzbekExample: U non yopish uchun xamir tayyorladi; xamirturush esa butun xamirni ko‘pirtirdi.

meanings.arabicGloss: أَيْ أَنَا الَّذِي كَوَّنْتُهُ وَصَنَعْتُهُ، وَأَنَا خَبِيرٌ بِهِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: «u mening qo‘limning xamiri» iborasida: uni men tarbiyalab yoki shakllantirganman va yaxshi bilaman
meanings.uzbekExample: U mening qo‘limning xamiri: uni men shakllantirganman va juda yaxshi bilaman.

issues: Ikkinchi ma’no shunchaki «o‘zim tayyorlagan narsa» emas; insonni o‘zi shakllantirib, yaxshi bilishini anglatuvchi majoziy ibora

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- حَقْلٌ خَصِيبٌ : كَثِيرُ النَّبَاتِ وَالْعُشْبِ- فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَدِبُّ حَتَّى أَتَى مَرجاً خَصِيباً كَثِيرَ الْمَاءِ وَالْكَلإِ :(ابن المقفع).|2- رَجُلٌ خَصِيبٌ : كَثِيرُ الْخَيْرِ.

meanings.arabicGloss: كَثِيرُ النَّبَاتِ وَالْعُشْبِ- فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَدِبُّ حَتَّى أَتَى مَرجاً خَصِيباً كَثِيرَ الْمَاءِ وَالْكَلإِ :(ابن المقفع).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: dala, yer yoki yaylov haqida: o‘t-o‘lani va o‘simligi ko‘p, serhosil
meanings.uzbekExample: U suv va o‘t-o‘lani ko‘p serhosil yaylovga yetib keldi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: yaxshiligi va ehsoni ko‘p
meanings.uzbekExample: U yaxshiligi ko‘p inson edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- خُبْزٌ فَطِيرٌ : خُبْزٌ تَمَّ طَهْيُهُ قَبْلَ اِخْتِمَارِهِ.|2- عَجِينٌ فَطِيرٌ : لَمْ يَخْتَمِرْ بَعْدُ.|3- رَأْيٌ فَطِيرٌ : رَأْيٌ بِلاَ تَفْكِيرٍ أَوْ رَوِيَّةٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: non haqida: xamiri achib ulgurmasdan pishirilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Non xamiri achib ulgurmasdan pishirildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: xamir haqida: hali achimagan, ko‘tarilmagan
meanings.uzbekExample: Xamir hali achimagan edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: fikr haqida: yetarlicha o‘ylab ko‘rilmagan, xom va shoshma-shosharlik bilan bildirilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U yetarlicha o‘ylanmagan xom fikr bildirdi.

issues: فَطِيرٌ «xamirturushsiz» bo‘lishi shart emas; manba xamirning hali achib ulgurmaganini aytadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- دَوَاءٌ نَجِيعٌ : نَافِعٌ.|2- طَعَامٌ نَجِيعٌ : نَافِعٌ لِلْبَدَنِ.|3- مَاءٌ نَجِيعٌ : هَنِيءٌ، مَرِيءٌ.
entries.uzbek: samarali; tanaga foydali; yoqimli va singimli

meanings.uzbekMeaning: dori haqida: foyda beradigan, samarali
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu samarali dori bemorga foyda berdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: taom haqida: tana uchun foydali va to‘yimli
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu taom tana uchun foydali edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: suv haqida: ichishga yoqimli, tomoqdan oson o‘tadigan va singimli
meanings.uzbekExample: Suv ichishga yoqimli va singimli edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- رَجُلٌ ذَرِعٌ : طَويلُ اللِّسانِ بِالشَّرِّ.|2- مُسافِرٌ ذَرِعٌ : يَسيرُ لَيْلاً وَنَهاراً.
entries.uzbek: yomonlikda tili uzun; kecha-kunduz yo‘l yuradigan

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: yomon va haqoratli so‘zlarni ko‘p gapiradigan, yomonlikda tili uzun
meanings.uzbekExample: U yomonlikda tili uzun kishi edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: musofir haqida: kecha-yu kunduz yo‘l yuradigan, yo‘l bosishda davomli
meanings.uzbekExample: Musofir kecha-yu kunduz yo‘l yurardi.

issues: طَويلُ اللِّسانِ بِالشَّرِّ oddiy «yomon so‘zli»dan kuchliroq, yomonlik va haqoratda tili uzunlikni bildiradi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- رَجُلٌ عَزِيبٌ : بَعِيدٌ عَنْ أَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ.|2- شَابٌّ عَزِيبٌ : غَيْرُ مُتَزَوِّجٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: oilasi va mol-mulkidan uzoqda yashayotgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U oilasi va mol-mulkidan uzoqda yashardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yigit yoki erkak haqida: uylanmagan, turmush qurmagan
meanings.uzbekExample: U hali uylanmagan yigit edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- رَجُلٌ عَقِيرٌ : لاَ يُولَدُ لَهُ وَلَدٌ.|2- وَقَفَ عَقِيراً : لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ لِخَوْفٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: erkak haqida: biologik jihatdan farzand ko‘ra olmaydigan, bepusht
meanings.uzbekExample: U farzand ko‘ra olmaydigan erkak edi.

meanings.arabicGloss: لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ لِخَوْفٍ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: qo‘rquvdan oldinga ham, orqaga ham yura olmay, qotib qolgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U qo‘rquvdan oldinga ham, orqaga ham siljiy olmay qotib qoldi.

issues: Farzandsizlik umumiy holat emas, manbada erkakning farzand ko‘ra olmasligi sifatida ta’riflangan

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- رَجُلٌ كَظِيمٌ لِغَيْظِهِ : كَاظِمٌ، أَيْ مُمْسِكٌ عَلَى مَا فِي نَفْسِهِ عِنْدَ الغَيْظِ. 2 :وَجَدَهُ كَظِيماً : مَهْمُوماً مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْحُزْنِ. | يوسف آية 82وَابْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ (قرآن).|3- كَظِيمُ البَابِ : مَا يُغْلَقُ بِهِ البَابُ.|4- إِنَّهَا لَكَظِيمُ الْخَلْخَالِ : لاَ يُسْمَعُ لَهُ صَوْتٌ لامْتِلاَئِهِ.
entries.uzbek: g‘azabini yutgan; qayg‘uga botgan; eshik tambasi; xalxali jim

meanings.arabicGloss: كَاظِمٌ، أَيْ مُمْسِكٌ عَلَى مَا فِي نَفْسِهِ عِنْدَ الغَيْظِ
meanings.uzbekMeaning: g‘azablanganida ichidagi tuyg‘uni oshkor etmay, g‘azabini bosib turadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U g‘azabini ichiga yutib, o‘zini tutdi.

meanings.arabicGloss: مَهْمُوماً مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْحُزْنِ. | يوسف آية 82وَابْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ (قرآن).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: qattiq qayg‘udan dili siqilgan, g‘amga botgan
meanings.uzbekExample: G‘amdan uning ko‘zlari oqarib ketdi va u qayg‘usini ichiga yutdi. (Qur’on, Yusuf surasi, 12:84)

meanings.uzbekMeaning: eshikni yopib turadigan tamba, ilgak yoki boshqa moslama
meanings.uzbekExample: U eshik tambasini yopdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: oyog‘i to‘laligi sabab xalxali zich turib, tovush chiqarmaydigan ayolga nisbatan ishlatiladigan tavsif
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning xalxali zich turgani uchun tovush chiqarmas edi.

issues: Manbadagi «2 :» nostandart ajratgich sabab birinchi ma’noga qo‘shilib ketgan edi; parser tuzatilib to‘rtta ma’no tiklandi
Manba oyatni Yusuf 12:82 deb ko‘rsatgan, ammo «وَابْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ...» Yusuf surasi 12:84 oyatidir
To‘rtinchi ma’no ayolning to‘laligini tarixiy tarzda tavsiflaydi; neytral ifoda tanlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- رَجُلٌ نَضِيرٌ : ذُو نَضَارَةٍ، جَمِيلٌ- نَضِيرُ الوَجْهِ.|2- مَرْجٌ نَضِيرٌ : أَخْضَرُ زَاهٍ.|3-  نَبَاتٌ مِنْ فَصِيلَةِ النَّرْجِسِيَّاتِ، مِنَ النَّبَاتَاتِ البَصَلِيَّةِ، مُعْظَمُهَا بَرِّيٌّ، وَبَعْضُهَا تَزْيِينِيٌّ.
entries.uzbek: yuzidan nur yog‘ilgan; yam-yashil; piyozboshli o‘simlik

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi yoki yuz haqida: tarovatli, chiroyli va yuzidan nur yog‘ilib turadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U tarovatli va chiroyli, yuzi nurli kishi edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘tloq yoki o‘simlik haqida: yashnab turgan, yam-yashil
meanings.uzbekExample: O‘tloq yam-yashil bo‘lib yashnab turardi.

meanings.arabicGloss: نَبَاتٌ مِنْ فَصِيلَةِ النَّرْجِسِيَّاتِ، مِنَ النَّبَاتَاتِ البَصَلِيَّةِ، مُعْظَمُهَا بَرِّيٌّ، وَبَعْضُهَا تَزْيِينِيٌّ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: nargislar oilasiga mansub piyozboshli o‘simlik; turlarining ko‘pi yovvoyi, ayrimlari manzarali
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu piyozboshli o‘simlikning ayrim turlari bezak uchun yetishtiriladi.

issues: Uchinchi ma’noda muayyan nargis turi deb toraytirilmadi; manbadagi nargislar oilasiga mansub piyozboshli o‘simlik ta’rifi saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- رَزيزُ الرَّعْدِ : أَزيزُ، دَويُّ، صَوْتُ الرَّعْدِ.|2- سَمِعَ رَزِيزاً : أَزيزاً، صَوْتاً.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: momaqaldiroqning gumburlagan, guldiragan tovushi
meanings.uzbekExample: Momaqaldiroqning gumburi eshitildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: g‘uvillash, guvillagan yoki davomli tovush
meanings.uzbekExample: U g‘uvillagan tovush eshitdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- رَشيحُ الأَرْضِ : ما علَى وَجْهِها مِنْ نَباتٍ.|2- رَشيحُ الجَسَدِ : عَرَقُهُ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yer yuzasida o‘sib turgan o‘simlik va ko‘katlar
meanings.uzbekExample: Yer yuzidagi o‘simliklar yam-yashil edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: badandan ajralib chiqadigan ter
meanings.uzbekExample: Issiqda uning badanidan ter chiqdi.

issues: Mavjud «tananing teri» yozuvi terini «skin» bilan chalkashtirgan; arabcha عَرَقُهُ badan terini bildiradi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- سَالَ الْجُرْحُ بِالغَثِيثِ : بِالصَّدِيدِ، بِالقَيْحِ.|2- وَلَدٌ غَثِيثٌ : مَهْزُولٌ، ضَعِيفٌ.|3- رَجُلٌ غَثِيثٌ : لاَ خَيْرَ فِيهِ.|4- عَاشَرْتُهُ عَلَى غَثِيثَةٍ فِيهِ : عَلَى فَسَادِ عَقْلٍ فِيهِ.
entries.uzbek: yiring; ozg‘in va nimjon; yaxshiligi yo‘q; aqli nosog‘lom

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yaradan oqadigan yiring yoki yiringli suyuqlik
meanings.uzbekExample: Yaradan yiring oqdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: juda ozg‘in, jismi zaif va nimjon
meanings.uzbekExample: U ozg‘in va nimjon bola edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: unda yaxshilik yo‘q deb salbiy baholangan
meanings.uzbekExample: Manbada u yaxshiligi yo‘q kishi deb ta’riflangan.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: aql va fikrlashdagi nosog‘lomlik yoki buzilish
meanings.uzbekExample: Men uning fikrlashidagi nosog‘lomlikka qaramay u bilan muomala qildim.

issues: Birinchi ma’no yara holati emas, yaradan oqadigan yiringning o‘zi
To‘rtinchi ma’no kamsituvchi tashxisga aylantirilmay, tarixiy aqliy nosog‘lomlik ta’rifi sifatida berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- سَيْفٌ فَتِيقٌ : حَادٌّ.|2- رَجُلٌ فَتِيقٌ : حَادُّ اللِّسَانِ.|3- صُبْحٌ فَتِيقٌ : مُشْرِقٌ.
entries.uzbek: o‘tkir qilich; tili o‘tkir; yorug‘ tong

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qilich yoki tig‘ haqida: o‘tkir
meanings.uzbekExample: Qilichning tig‘i o‘tkir edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: tili o‘tkir, keskin gapiradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U tili o‘tkir kishi edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tong haqida: yorishgan, charog‘on
meanings.uzbekExample: Tong yorishib, charog‘on bo‘ldi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- سِكِّينٌ رَهيفٌ :حادٌّ.|2- رَهيفُ الإِحْساسِ : رَقيقُهُ، مُرْهَفُ الإِحْساسِ- طَبْعٌ رَهيفٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: pichoq yoki tig‘ haqida: juda o‘tkir
meanings.uzbekExample: Pichoqning tig‘i juda o‘tkir edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: his-tuyg‘u yoki tabiat haqida: nozik, ta’sirchan va sezgir
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning his-tuyg‘usi nozik va sezgir edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- شَاةٌ ضَرِيعٌ : حَسَنَةُ الضَّرْعِ.|2-  نَبَاتُ العَوْسَجِ الشَّائِكِ. الغاشية آية 6 لَيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلاَّ مِنْ ضَرِيعٍ، لاَ يُسْمِنُ وَلاَ يُغْنِي مِنْ جُوعٍ . (قرآن).
entries.uzbek: yelini yaxshi rivojlangan sovliq; Dari’ tikanli o‘simligi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: sovliq yoki urg‘ochi echki haqida: yelini yaxshi rivojlangan
meanings.uzbekExample: Sovliqning yelini yaxshi rivojlangan edi.

meanings.arabicGloss: نَبَاتُ العَوْسَجِ الشَّائِكِ. الغاشية آية 6 لَيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلاَّ مِنْ ضَرِيعٍ، لاَ يُسْمِنُ وَلاَ يُغْنِي مِنْ جُوعٍ . (قرآن).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: Dari’ — manbada tikanli yovvoyi o‘simlik sifatida izohlangan va Qur’onda do‘zax ahlining taomi sifatida zikr qilingan
meanings.uzbekExample: Ular uchun Dari’dan boshqa taom yo‘qdir; u semirtirmaydi ham, ochlikdan qutqarmaydi ham. (Qur’on, G‘oshiya surasi, 88:6–7)

issues: شَاةٌ sigir emas; sovliq yoki urg‘ochi echkini bildiradi
G‘oshiya 88:6–7 misoli Dari’ning diniy kontekstini to‘liq ochadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- شَعْرٌ دَهينٌ : مَدْهونٌ- لِحْيَةٌ دَهينٌ :-جِلْدٌ دَهينٌ.|2- وَلَدٌ دَهينٌ : ضَعيفٌ- أَمْرٌ دَهينٌ :-وَظَنَّ بِنا ظَنّاً دَهيناً.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: soch, soqol yoki teri haqida: moy surtilgan, yog‘langan
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning sochi, soqoli va terisiga moy surtilgan edi.

meanings.arabicGloss: ضَعيفٌ- أَمْرٌ دَهينٌ :-وَظَنَّ بِنا ظَنّاً دَهيناً.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola, ish, gumon yoki fikr haqida: zaif, sust va ishonchli asosga ega bo‘lmagan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bola zaif, ish sust, uning biz haqimizdagi gumoni esa asossiz edi.

issues: Mavjud tarjima uch ma’no bergan, manbada ikkitadir; bola, ish va gumondagi zaiflik bitta ko‘chma ma’noga birlashtirildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- صَمِيمُ الْبَرْدِ : أَشَدُّهُ، قُوَّتُهُ- صَمِيمُ الْحَرِّ.|2- صَمِيمُ الْعُضْوِ : الْعَظْمُ الَّذِي بِهِ قِوَامُهُ.|3- مِنْ صَمِيمِ قَلْبِهِ : مِنْ عُمْقِهِ وَخَالِصِهِ، مِنْ سُوَيْدَائِهِ.|4- أَصَابَهُ فِي الصَّمِيمِ : فِي وَسَطِ الشَّيْءِ، فِي عُمْقِهِ- مَسَّهُ فِي الصَّمِيمِ.|5- لَمْ يَخْرُجْ عَنْ صَمِيمِ الْمَوْضُوعِ : عَنْ صُلْبِهِ وَجَوْهَرِهِ.|6- وَطَنِيٌّ صَمِيمٌ : خَالِصٌ.
entries.uzbek: eng kuchli daraja; tayanch suyak; tub; markaz; mohiyat; chin

meanings.uzbekMeaning: sovuq yoki issiqning eng kuchli, avjiga chiqqan darajasi
meanings.uzbekExample: U qahraton sovuqning va jazirama issiqning avjini ko‘rdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: a’zoni tik va barqaror tutib turadigan asosiy tayanch suyak
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu suyak a’zoning asosiy tayanchi hisoblanadi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qalbning eng tubi, chuquri va eng xolis joyi
meanings.uzbekExample: U qalbining tubidan samimiy tilak bildirdi.

meanings.arabicGloss: فِي وَسَطِ الشَّيْءِ، فِي عُمْقِهِ- مَسَّهُ فِي الصَّمِيمِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: biror narsaning o‘rtasi, markazi yoki eng chuqur joyi
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu zarba uning eng nozik va markaziy joyiga tegdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: mavzu yoki masalaning o‘zagi, asosiy mazmuni va mohiyati
meanings.uzbekExample: U mavzuning mohiyatidan chetga chiqmadi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: vatanparvar yoki mansublik haqida: chin, sof va samimiy
meanings.uzbekExample: U chin vatanparvar edi.

issues: Oltinchi ma’nodagi وَطَنِيٌّ صَمِيمٌ tabiiy o‘zbekchada «chin vatanparvar» bo‘ladi, «sof haqiqiy milliy» emas

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- ضَرِيسُ الظَّهْرِ :فِقَارُهُ.|2- فَقِيرٌ ضَرِيسٌ : جَائِعٌ جِدّاً.|3- بِئْرٌ ضَرِيسٌ : مَبْنِيَةٌ بِالْحِجَارَةِ.
entries.uzbek: umurtqalar; juda och; tosh terilgan quduq

meanings.uzbekMeaning: orqaning umurtqa suyaklari
meanings.uzbekExample: Orqa umurtqalari gavdani tik tutadi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kambag‘al kishi haqida: juda och
meanings.uzbekExample: U juda och qolgan kambag‘al edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: quduq haqida: devori tosh bilan terib mustahkamlangan
meanings.uzbekExample: Quduq devori tosh bilan terilgan edi.

issues: ضَرِيسُ الظَّهْرِ «umurtqaga oid» sifat emas, orqa umurtqalari degan ot ma’nosi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- طَعَامٌ وَخِيمٌ :وَبِيءٌ.|2- أَرْضٌ وَخِيمَةٌ : وَبِيئَةٌ.|3- بَيْتٌ وَخِيمٌ : غَيْرُ مُلاَئِمٍ لِلسَّكَنِ.|4- خَطَأٌ وَخِيمٌ : فَادِحٌ- اِرْتَكَبَ أَخْطَاءً وَخِيمَةً.|5- عَمَلٌ وَخِيمُ العَاقِبَةِ : مُضِرٌّ، رَدِيءٌ، ضَارٌّ.
entries.uzbek: zararli; nosog‘lom; yashashga yaroqsiz; og‘ir; oqibati yomon

meanings.uzbekMeaning: taom haqida: sog‘liq uchun zararli, og‘ir yoki yomon ta’sirli
meanings.uzbekExample: Zararli taom uning sog‘lig‘iga yomon ta’sir qildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yer yoki hudud haqida: havosi-suvi nosog‘lom, kasallik tarqalish xavfi bor
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu hudud sog‘liq uchun nosog‘lom edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: uy haqida: yashash uchun noqulay yoki yaroqsiz
meanings.uzbekExample: Uy yashash uchun yaroqsiz edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: xato haqida: juda jiddiy, og‘ir va katta zarar keltiradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U og‘ir xatoga yo‘l qo‘ydi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ish yoki harakat haqida: oqibati zararli, yomon va xavfli
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu ishning oqibati zararli bo‘ldi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- طِفْلٌ رَميزٌ : كَثيرُ الحَرَكَةِ.|2- أَميرٌ رَميزٌ : مُكَرَّمٌ، مُعَظَّمٌ، مُبَجَّلٌ.|3- وَلَدٌ رَميزٌ :رَزينٌ، عاقِلٌ.|4- نَسَبٌ رَميزٌ : أَصيلٌ.
entries.uzbek: serharakat; e’zozlangan; vazmin va aqlli; nasabi asl

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola haqida: juda serharakat
meanings.uzbekExample: Bola juda serharakat edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: amir yoki rahbar haqida: e’zozlangan, ulug‘langan va hurmatli
meanings.uzbekExample: Amir e’zozlangan va hurmatli edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola yoki yigit haqida: vazmin va aqlli
meanings.uzbekExample: U vazmin va aqlli bola edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: nasab haqida: asl, qadimiy va sharafli
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning nasabi asl va sharafli edi.

issues: To‘rtinchi ma’no shaxsning aslzodaligi emas, nasabning aslligi va sharafliligi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- عَظْمٌ وَقِيرٌ : مَصْدُوعٌ، مَشْقُوقٌ.|2- وَقِيرُ الصَّخْرَةِ : النُّقْرَةُ، الْحُفْرَةُ العَظِيمَةُ فِيهَا تَمْسِكُ الْمَاءَ.|3- وَقِيرُ الغَنَمِ : القَطِيعُ مِنْهُ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ.|4- رَجُلٌ وَقِيرٌ : أَثْقَلَهُ الدَّيْنُ.|5- وَلَدٌ وَقِيرٌ : ذَلِيلٌ، مُهَانٌ.
entries.uzbek: darz ketgan suyak; qoyatosh chuquri; qo‘y suruvi; qarzga botgan; xo‘rlangan

meanings.uzbekMeaning: suyak haqida: yorilgan yoki darz ketgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Suyak darz ketgan edi.

meanings.arabicGloss: النُّقْرَةُ، الْحُفْرَةُ العَظِيمَةُ فِيهَا تَمْسِكُ الْمَاءَ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: qoyatoshdagi suv to‘planib turadigan katta o‘yiq yoki chuqur
meanings.uzbekExample: Qoyatoshning katta o‘yig‘ida suv to‘planib turardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qo‘ylar suruvi va unga qo‘shilib yurganlar
meanings.uzbekExample: Qo‘ylar suruvi yaylovga chiqdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: qarz og‘irligidan ezilgan, qarzga botgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U qarz og‘irligidan ezilgan edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola yoki kishi haqida: xo‘rlangan, tahqirlangan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bola xo‘rlangan va tahqirlangan edi.

issues: Ikkinchi ma’no har qanday chuqur emas, qoyatoshda suvni ushlab qoladigan katta o‘yiq

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- فَاحَ عَبِيرٌ : أَخْلاَطٌ مِنَ الطِّيبِ.|2- قَوْمٌ عَبِيرٌ : كَثِيرُونَ.|3- سَهْمٌ عَبِيرٌ : كَثِيرُ الرِّيشِ.
entries.uzbek: xushbo‘y moddalar aralashmasi; juda ko‘p; pati ko‘p o‘q

meanings.uzbekMeaning: turli xushbo‘y moddalar qo‘shilishidan tayyorlangan aralashma va undan taraladigan xushbo‘y hid
meanings.uzbekExample: Xushbo‘y moddalar aralashmasining hidi taraldi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: jamoa yoki kishilar haqida: soni juda ko‘p
meanings.uzbekExample: Ular juda ko‘p sonli jamoa edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘q haqida: orqa qismiga ko‘p pat o‘rnatilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: O‘qning orqa qismiga ko‘p pat o‘rnatilgan edi.

issues: Birinchi ma’no shunchaki xushbo‘y hid emas, xushbo‘y moddalar aralashmasi va undan taraladigan hid

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- فَشِيشُ الكُرَةِ :صَوْتُ الْهَوَاءِ الْخَارِجِ مِنْهَا.|2- فَشِيشُ الْحَيَّةِ :صَوْتُ جِلْدِهَا.
entries.uzbek: to‘pdan havo chiqish tovushi; ilon terisi shitiri

meanings.uzbekMeaning: to‘p yoki puflangan buyumdan havo chiqayotganda paydo bo‘ladigan tovush
meanings.uzbekExample: To‘pdan havo chiqish tovushi eshitildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ilon harakatlanganda terisi yoki tangachalaridan chiqadigan shitirlash tovushi
meanings.uzbekExample: Ilon terisining shitirlashi eshitildi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- فَضَحَ نَسِيفَهُ : سِرَّهُ.|2- كَلاَمٌ نَسِيفٌ : خَفِيٌّ.|3- دَقِيقٌ نَسِيفٌ : مُغَرْبَلٌ.
entries.uzbek: sir; past ovozli gap; elangan un

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yashirin saqlanadigan sir
meanings.uzbekExample: U uning sirini fosh qildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: gap yoki ovoz haqida: past, pinhona va boshqalarga aniq eshitilmaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U past va pinhona ovozda gapirdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: un haqida: elakdan o‘tkazilgan, elangan
meanings.uzbekExample: Elangan undan xamir qorildi.

issues: فَضَحَ نَسِيفَهُ iborasida نَسِيف sirli sifat emas, fosh qilingan sirning o‘zi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- قَدَّمَ رَأْياً سَخِيفاً : تَافِهاً ضَعِيفاً لاَ قِيمَةَ لَهُ.|2- رَجُلٌ سَخِيفٌ : تَافِهٌ، أَبْلَهُ، مَعْتُوهٌ- هُوَ سَخِيفُ العَقْلِ.|3- يَكْتُبُ بِأُسْلُوبٍ سَخِيفٍ : ضَعِيفٍ، هَزِيلٍ، تَرَاكِيبُهُ مُهَلْهَلَةٌ.
entries.uzbek: sayoz va qadrsiz; fikri zaif; uslubi bo‘sh

meanings.uzbekMeaning: fikr yoki taklif haqida: sayoz, zaif, arzimas va qiymatsiz
meanings.uzbekExample: U sayoz va qiymatsiz fikr bildirdi.

meanings.arabicGloss: تَافِهٌ، أَبْلَهُ، مَعْتُوهٌ- هُوَ سَخِيفُ العَقْلِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi yoki aql haqida: fikrlashi sayoz, mulohazasi zaif va bema’ni ish tutadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Manbada u fikrlashi sayoz kishi sifatida tasvirlangan.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yozuv uslubi haqida: zaif, bo‘sh va gap tuzilmalari pala-partish
meanings.uzbekExample: U bo‘sh, tuzilmalari pala-partish uslubda yozadi.

issues: Ikkinchi ma’no kamsituvchi zamonaviy yorliqqa aylantirilmadi; fikrlash sayozligi va mulohaza zaifligi sifatida izohlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- كَاتِبٌ شَهِيرٌ : مَعْرُوفٌ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ، ذَائِعُ الصِّيتِ، لَهُ شُهْرَةٌ- شَهِيرَاتُ النِّسَاءِ.|2- شَهِيرَةُ : اِسْمُ عَلَمٍ لِلْإِنَاثِ.
entries.uzbek: mashhur, dong‘i ketgan; Shahira ayol ismi

meanings.arabicGloss: مَعْرُوفٌ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ، ذَائِعُ الصِّيتِ، لَهُ شُهْرَةٌ- شَهِيرَاتُ النِّسَاءِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: odamlar orasida mashhur, taniqli va dong‘i ketgan
meanings.uzbekExample: U odamlar orasida mashhur yozuvchi edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: Shahira — ayollarga qo‘yiladigan atoqli ism
meanings.uzbekExample: Shahira ayol ismi sifatida qo‘llanadi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- كَلاَمٌ نَظِيمٌ : أَيْ مَنْظُومٌ شِعْراً.|2- عِقْدٌ نَظِيمٌ : مَنْظُومٌ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: so‘z yoki matn haqida: she’riy vaznda nazmga solingan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu so‘zlar she’riy shaklda nazmga solingan edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: marjon yoki munchoq haqida: donalari ipga birin-ketin terilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Marjon donalari ipga terilgan edi.

issues: Ikkinchi ma’no umumiy «tartiblangan» emas, marjon donalarining ipga terilganini bildiradi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- كَلاَمٌ وَجِيزٌ : مُقْتَصَرٌ، مُخْتَصَرٌ- عِبَارَةٌ وَجِيزَةٌ.|2- حَضَرَ مُنْذُ فَتْرَةٍ وَجِيزَةٍ : مُنْذُ فَتْرَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: gap, ibora yoki matn haqida: qisqa, ixcham va lo‘nda
meanings.uzbekExample: U qisqa va lo‘nda gapirdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: vaqt yoki muddat haqida: qisqa, oz
meanings.uzbekExample: U bundan qisqa vaqt oldin kelgan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- مَاءٌ غَمِيرٌ : كَثِيرٌ.|2- نَبْتٌ غَمِيرٌ : نَبْتٌ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَصْلِ النَّبْتِ.
entries.uzbek: mo‘l suv; o‘simlik tubidan chiqqan yangi novda

meanings.uzbekMeaning: suv haqida: miqdori ko‘p, mo‘l
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu yerda suv mo‘l edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘simlikning tubi yoki ildiz bo‘g‘zidan o‘sib chiqqan yangi novda yoki bachki
meanings.uzbekExample: O‘simlik tubidan yangi bachki o‘sib chiqdi.

issues: Ikkinchi ma’nodagi takroriy «ildizidan chiqqan o‘simlik» o‘rniga botanik jihatdan aniq «tubdan chiqqan yangi novda yoki bachki» berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- مَاءٌ نَمِيٌر : مَاءٌ نَافِعٌ عَذْبٌ.|2- شَرَفٌ نَمِيرٌ : شَرَفٌ زَاكٍ- لَهُ حَسَبٌ نَمِيرٌ.
entries.uzbek: chuchuk va foydali suv; pok va yuksak sharaf

meanings.uzbekMeaning: suv haqida: chuchuk, ichishga yoqimli va foydali
meanings.uzbekExample: Ular chuchuk va ichishga foydali suv topdilar.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: sharaf, obro‘ yoki nasab haqida: pok, yuksak va e’tiborli
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning sharafi yuksak, nasabi esa e’tiborli edi.

issues: عَذْبٌ suvning «toza»ligini emas, chuchuk va ichishga yoqimliligini bildiradi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- مَدِيدُ الدَّوَابِّ : العَلَفُ.|2- رَجُلٌ مَدِيدُ القَامَةِ : طَوِيلُ القَامَةِ- قَامَةٌ مَدِيدَةٌ.|3- تَمَنَّى لَهُ عُمْراً مَدِيداً : طَوِيلاً.|4- حِبَالٌ مَدِيدَةٌ :مَمْدُودَةٌ.|5- البَحْرُ الْمَدِيدُ : بَحْرٌ مِنْ بُحُورِ الشِّعْرِ العَرَبِيِّ وَيَتَأَلَّفُ مِنْ سِتَّةِ أَجْزَاءٍ: | فَاعِلاَتُنْ فَاعِلُنْ فَاعِلاَتُنْ ... ... فَاعِلاَتُنْ فَاعِلُنْ فَاعِلاَتُنْ
entries.uzbek: yem-xashak; uzun bo‘yli; uzoq; cho‘zilgan; madid vazni

meanings.uzbekMeaning: uy hayvonlariga beriladigan yem-xashak
meanings.uzbekExample: U hayvonlarga yem-xashak berdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi yoki qomat haqida: uzun, baland bo‘yli
meanings.uzbekExample: U uzun bo‘yli kishi edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: umr yoki vaqt haqida: uzoq davom etadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U unga uzoq umr tiladi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: arqon yoki cho‘ziq buyum haqida: uzunasiga yoyilgan, cho‘zilgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Arqonlar uzunasiga cho‘zib qo‘yilgan edi.

meanings.arabicGloss: بَحْرٌ مِنْ بُحُورِ الشِّعْرِ العَرَبِيِّ وَيَتَأَلَّفُ مِنْ سِتَّةِ أَجْزَاءٍ: | فَاعِلاَتُنْ فَاعِلُنْ فَاعِلاَتُنْ ... ... فَاعِلاَتُنْ فَاعِلُنْ فَاعِلاَتُنْ
meanings.uzbekMeaning: al-Bahr al-madid — arab aruzidagi she’riy vaznlardan biri; olti rukni «فَاعِلَاتُنْ فَاعِلُنْ فَاعِلَاتُنْ ... فَاعِلَاتُنْ فَاعِلُنْ فَاعِلَاتُنْ» tartibida keladi
meanings.uzbekExample: Shoir baytni madid vaznida yozdi.

issues: Madid bahrining manbada berilgan olti ruknli qolipi to‘liq saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- مَكانٌ ظَليفٌ :خَشِنٌ.|2- أَرْضٌ ظَليفَةٌ : شَديدَةٌ، صُلْبَةٌ، غَليظَةٌ.|3- رَجُلٌ ظَليفٌ : سَيِّءُ الحالِ.|4- ذَهَبَ بِهِ ظَليفاً : مَجَّاناً، أَي بِغَيْرِ ثَمَنٍ.|5- ذَهَبَ دَمُهُ ظَليفاً : هَدَراً.|6- هِيَ ظَليفَةُ النَّفْسِ : عَزيزَةُ النَّفْسِ.|7- أَخَذَ الشَّيْءَ بِظَليفَتِهِ : بِأَسْرِهِ، أَي لم يَتْرُكْ مِنْهُ شَيْئاً.
entries.uzbek: dag‘al; qattiq yer; ahvoli yomon; tekin; tovonsiz; oriyatli; butunlay

meanings.uzbekMeaning: joy haqida: yuzasi qo‘pol va dag‘al
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu joyning yuzasi qo‘pol va dag‘al edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yer haqida: juda qattiq, zich va dag‘al
meanings.uzbekExample: Yer juda qattiq va zich edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: ahvoli yomon, og‘ir sharoitda
meanings.uzbekExample: U yomon ahvolda edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: haq yoki narx to‘lamasdan, tekin
meanings.uzbekExample: U uni hech qanday haq to‘lamay olib ketdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: «qoni zoye ketdi» iborasida: qasos yoki tovon olinmay, behuda ketgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning qoni uchun qasos ham, tovon ham olinmadi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: o‘z qadr-qimmatini saqlaydigan, oriyatli va izzat-nafsli
meanings.uzbekExample: U oriyatli va o‘z qadrini biladigan ayol edi.

meanings.arabicGloss: بِأَسْرِهِ، أَي لم يَتْرُكْ مِنْهُ شَيْئاً.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: biror narsani hech bir qismini qoldirmay, butunlay va to‘lig‘icha olish
meanings.uzbekExample: U narsaning hech bir qismini qoldirmay, hammasini oldi.

issues: «Qoni ظَليفاً ketdi» oddiy «behuda» emas, qasos yoki tovon olinmay zoye ketishni bildiradi
Yettinchi ma’no narsaning biror qismini qoldirmay to‘lig‘icha olishdir

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- مَكانٌ ظَليلٌ : مَكانٌ بِهِ ظِلٌّ كَثيفٌ دائِمٌ.|2- ظِلُّ ظَليلٌ : ظِلٌّ كَثيفٌ دائِمٌ- واحَةٌ يَحوطُها ماءٌ غَزيرٌ وَظِلٌّ ظَليلٌ.|3- اِسْتَقَرَّ طولَ النَّهارِ في الظَّليلَةِ : في الرَّوْضَةِ كَثيفَةِ الأَشْجارِ- غابَةٌ ظَليلَةٌ.
entries.uzbek: quyuq soyali joy; qalin soya; daraxtzor sayilgoh

meanings.uzbekMeaning: joy haqida: quyuq va doimiy soyasi bor, salqin
meanings.uzbekExample: U quyuq soyali joyda dam oldi.

meanings.arabicGloss: ظِلٌّ كَثيفٌ دائِمٌ- واحَةٌ يَحوطُها ماءٌ غَزيرٌ وَظِلٌّ ظَليلٌ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: soya haqida: quyuq, keng va uzoq saqlanadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Voha mo‘l suv va quyuq soya bilan o‘ralgan edi.

meanings.arabicGloss: في الرَّوْضَةِ كَثيفَةِ الأَشْجارِ- غابَةٌ ظَليلَةٌ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: daraxtlari qalin o‘sgan sayilgoh, bog‘ yoki o‘rmon
meanings.uzbekExample: U kun bo‘yi daraxtlari qalin sayilgohda qoldi.

issues: Birinchi ma’no soyali joy, ikkinchisi soyaning o‘zi, uchinchisi qalin daraxtzor sayilgoh sifatida ajratildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- ماءٌ زَليلٌ : عَذْبٌ، صافٍ.|2-  نَوْعٌ مِنَ الحَلْوَى يُتَّخَذُ مِنَ الطَّحِينِ والماءِ والعَسَلِ.
entries.uzbek: chuchuk va tiniq suv; un, suv va asalli shirinlik

meanings.uzbekMeaning: suv haqida: chuchuk va tiniq
meanings.uzbekExample: Suv chuchuk va tiniq edi.

meanings.arabicGloss: نَوْعٌ مِنَ الحَلْوَى يُتَّخَذُ مِنَ الطَّحِينِ والماءِ والعَسَلِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: un, suv va asal qo‘shib tayyorlanadigan shirinlik turi
meanings.uzbekExample: Shirinlik un, suv va asaldan tayyorlandi.

issues: Shirinlikning un, suv va asaldan tayyorlanishi tiklandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- نَامَ عَلَى الْقَضِيضِ : عَلَى صِغَارِ الْحَصَى.|2- جَاءوا بِقَضِّهِمْ وَقَضِيضِهِمْ : أَيْ جَمِيعِهِمْ.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: mayda tosh va shag‘al
meanings.uzbekExample: U mayda shag‘al ustida uxladi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: «qaddi-qadidi bilan keldi» iborasida: birortasi qolmay, hammasi birgalikda
meanings.uzbekExample: Ularning birortasi qolmay, hammasi keldi.

issues: Birinchi ma’no «toshlar ustida yotgan» holat emas, mayda tosh va shag‘alning o‘zi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- نَبَاتٌ صَرِيمٌ : مَا قُطِعَ مِنْهُ.|2- شَجَرٌ صَرِيمٌ : مَا جُمِعَ ثَمَرُهُ.|3- صَرِيمٌ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ : قِطْعَةٌ مِنْهُ.
entries.uzbek: kesilgan o‘simlik; mevasi terilgan daraxt; tun bo‘lagi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘simlik haqida: kesib olingan qismi
meanings.uzbekExample: O‘simlikning bir qismi kesib olindi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: daraxt haqida: mevasi terib olingan
meanings.uzbekExample: Daraxtning mevalari terib olingan edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tunning bir bo‘lagi yoki qismi
meanings.uzbekExample: U tunning bir qismida yo‘lga chiqdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- نَبَاتٌ يَبِيسٌ : يَابِسٌ.|2- يَبِيسُ الْمَاءِ : الْعَرَقُ الْجَافُّ.|3- رَجُلٌ يَبِيسٌ : لاَ خَيْرَ فِيهِ- اِمْرَأَةٌ يَبِيسٌ.
entries.uzbek: qurigan o‘simlik; qurib qolgan ter; yaxshiligi yo‘q

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘simlik haqida: namini yo‘qotgan, qurigan
meanings.uzbekExample: O‘simlik qurib qolgan edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: badanda qurib qolgan ter
meanings.uzbekExample: Badanidagi ter qurib qolgan edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: erkak yoki ayol haqida: unda yaxshilik yo‘q deb salbiy baholangan
meanings.uzbekExample: Manbada bu sifat yaxshiligi yo‘q kishiga nisbatan qo‘llangan.

issues: يَبِيسُ الْمَاءِ bu ta’rifda «qurigan suv» emas, keyingi izohga ko‘ra badanda qurigan ter

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- نَزِيفُ الدَّمِ : خُرُوجُهُ غَزِيراً مِنَ الأَنْفِ أَوِ الفَمِ أَوْ نَحْوِهِمَا بِسَبَبِ مَرَضٍ أَوْ جُرْحٍ.|2- تَعَرَّضَ لِنَزِيفٍ دَاخِلِيٍّ : نَزِيفٌ في الدِّمَاغِ أَوفي غَيْرِهِ مِنْ أَعْضَاءِ الْجَسَدِ.
entries.uzbek: ko‘p qon ketishi; ichki qon ketishi

meanings.arabicGloss: خُرُوجُهُ غَزِيراً مِنَ الأَنْفِ أَوِ الفَمِ أَوْ نَحْوِهِمَا بِسَبَبِ مَرَضٍ أَوْ جُرْحٍ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: kasallik yoki jarohat sabab burun, og‘iz yoki boshqa joydan qonning ko‘p oqishi
meanings.uzbekExample: Jarohat sabab ko‘p qon ketdi.

meanings.arabicGloss: نَزِيفٌ في الدِّمَاغِ أَوفي غَيْرِهِ مِنْ أَعْضَاءِ الْجَسَدِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: miya yoki tananing boshqa a’zosi ichida yuz beradigan ichki qon ketishi
meanings.uzbekExample: Bemorda ichki qon ketishi aniqlandi.

issues: نَزِيفٌ bu ta’riflarda sifat emas, qon ketishi hodisasini bildiruvchi ot

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- هُوَ أنِيسُ وَحْدَتِي :الْمَأنُوسُ بِهِ.|2- القِطَّةُ حَيَوَانٌ أنِيسٌ : ألِيفٌ.|3- أنيسُ، ة :اِسْمُ عَلَمٍ لِلْمُذَكَّرِ، أوِ الْمُؤنث.
entries.uzbek: yolg‘izlikdagi hamroh; qo‘lga o‘rgangan; Anis yoki Anisa ismi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yolg‘izlikni ketkazadigan, yonida o‘tirish yoqimli bo‘lgan hamroh
meanings.uzbekExample: U mening yolg‘izligimdagi yaqin hamrohim edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: hayvon haqida: odamga o‘rgangan, yovvoyi bo‘lmagan va yuvosh
meanings.uzbekExample: Mushuk odamga o‘rgangan yuvosh hayvondir.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: Anis — erkaklarga, Anisa — ayollarga qo‘yiladigan atoqli ism
meanings.uzbekExample: Anis va Anisa shaxs ismlari sifatida qo‘llanadi.

issues: Birinchi ma’no umumiy do‘stonalik emas, yolg‘izlikni ketkazadigan hamroh
Ikkinchi ma’no «uy hayvoniga xos muloyim» emas, odamga o‘rgangan va yuvosh hayvon

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- هُوَ جَسِيمُ البَدَنِ : البَدِينُ، الضَّخْمُ، الغَلِيظُ.|2- طَلَبَ مِنْهُ مَبْلَغاً جَسِيماً :ضَخْماً.|3- إِنَّهُ لأَمْرٌ جَسِيمٌ : خَطِيرٌ، فَادِحٌ- خَطَأٌ جَسِيمٌ :-لَحِقَتْهُ أَضْرَارٌ جَسِيمَةٌ.
entries.uzbek: yirik gavdali; juda katta; jiddiy va og‘ir

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi yoki tana haqida: yirik gavdali, katta va yo‘g‘on
meanings.uzbekExample: U yirik gavdali kishi edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: pul yoki miqdor haqida: juda katta
meanings.uzbekExample: U undan juda katta pul miqdorini so‘radi.

meanings.arabicGloss: خَطِيرٌ، فَادِحٌ- خَطَأٌ جَسِيمٌ :-لَحِقَتْهُ أَضْرَارٌ جَسِيمَةٌ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: ish, xato yoki zarar haqida: jiddiy, og‘ir va katta
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu jiddiy ish edi; og‘ir xato katta zarar keltirdi.

issues: Birinchi ma’noda semizlik majburiy belgi emas; yirik va yo‘g‘on gavda neytral tarzda berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- هُوَ عَرِيقُ النَّسَبِ : مِنْ أَصْلٍ مَعْرُوفٍ لاَ غُبَارَ عَلَيْهِ، أَصِيلٌ- شَعْبٌ عَرِيقٌ فِي الْمَجْدِ وَالسُّؤْدُدِ.|2- عَرِيقٌ فِي القِدَمِ : قَدِيمٌ جِدّاً.
entries.uzbek: nasabi asl va qadimiy; juda qadimdan mavjud

meanings.arabicGloss: مِنْ أَصْلٍ مَعْرُوفٍ لاَ غُبَارَ عَلَيْهِ، أَصِيلٌ- شَعْبٌ عَرِيقٌ فِي الْمَجْدِ وَالسُّؤْدُدِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: nasab, xalq yoki obro‘ haqida: asl ildizi ma’lum, qadimdan sharaf va ulug‘likka ega
meanings.uzbekExample: U nasabi asl oiladan, xalqi esa qadimiy sharaf va ulug‘lik egasi edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: vaqt yoki tarix haqida: ildizi juda qadimga boradigan, juda qadimiy
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu an’ana juda qadimdan mavjud.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- هُوَ في عَيْشٍ رَطيبٍ : في عَيْش هَنِيءٍ، مَيْسورٍ، مُريحٍ.|2- غُصْنٌ رَطيبٌ : لَيِّنٌ ناعِمٌ- رِيشٌ رَطِيبٌ.
entries.uzbek: rohatli va farovon; yangi, nam va mayin

meanings.uzbekMeaning: hayot yoki turmush haqida: rohatli, farovon va qulay
meanings.uzbekExample: U rohatli va farovon hayot kechirardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: novda yoki pat haqida: yangi, nami bor, egiluvchan va mayin
meanings.uzbekExample: Yangi novda nam va egiluvchan, pat esa mayin edi.

issues: Ikkinchi ma’noda yumshoqlik bilan birga yangi, nam va egiluvchanlik ham saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- وَجْهٌ عَفِيرٌ : مُعَفَّرٌ، مُمَرَّغٌ فِي التُّرَابِ.|2- خُبْزٌ عَفِيرٌ : بِلاَ أُدْمٍ.
entries.uzbek: tuproqqa belangan yuz; nonxurushsiz quruq non

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yuz haqida: tuproqqa belangan yoki tuproqqa surkalgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning yuzi tuproqqa belangan edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: non haqida: yoniga nonxurush, qayla yoki boshqa qo‘shimcha qo‘yilmagan quruq non
meanings.uzbekExample: U nonxurushsiz quruq non yedi.

issues: بِلاَ أُدْمٍ faqat «yog‘siz» degani emas; nonxurush, qayla yoki qo‘shimchasiz quruq non

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- وَقِيدُ النَّارِ : مَا تُشْعَلُ بِهِ النَّارُ كَالْحَطَبِ وَغَيْرِهِ.|2- أَشْعَلَ سِيجَارَتَهُ بِوَقِيدَةٍ : بِثِقَابٍ، بِعُودِ ثِقَابٍ، بِعُودِ الكِبْرِيتِ.

meanings.arabicGloss: مَا تُشْعَلُ بِهِ النَّارُ كَالْحَطَبِ وَغَيْرِهِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: olovni yoqish yoki yondirib turish uchun ishlatiladigan o‘tin va boshqa yoqilg‘i
meanings.uzbekExample: U olov yoqish uchun o‘tin tayyorladi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: olov yoqadigan gugurt cho‘pi
meanings.uzbekExample: U sigaretini gugurt cho‘pi bilan yoqdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعِيل).|1- وَلَدٌ ذَكيرٌ : جَيِّدُ الذِّكْرِ والحِفْظِ.|2- حَديدٌ ذَكيرٌ : مِنْ مَعْدِنٍ جَيِّدٍ، ذَكَرٌ.
entries.uzbek: xotirasi kuchli; yuqori navli va qattiq temir

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bola yoki kishi haqida: eslab qolishi va yodlashi yaxshi, xotirasi kuchli
meanings.uzbekExample: Bolaning xotirasi kuchli, yodlash qobiliyati yaxshi edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: temir haqida: yaxshi ma’danli, yuqori navli, qattiq va mustahkam
meanings.uzbekExample: Asbob yuqori navli, qattiq temirdan yasaldi.

issues: Ikkinchi ma’no umumiy metall emas, yaxshi ma’danli, yuqori navli va qattiq temirga tegishli
